records.source_file: E01-E05-E06-设计约束与历史指标摘录.json

limits: Evidence recall only: normalized excerpt substring in returned original chunk text with the fixed source identity; not answer quality, entailment, page/bbox correctness or general semantic recall.
Positive cases and reference order are unchanged from the six frozen cases / 26 prior runs; the negative answering case is outside this artifact's original scope.

QA measurements call real qa.retrieve (including real ACL/fixed-version selection, similarity gate and disabled rerank); raw retrieval ranks are recorded separately. No generator/chat/vision requests are made.

Cross-document measurements call the real router function in-process, with its real authorized-document predicate and search_contexts constrained to the three frozen version IDs; global pre-grouping rank matches the old measurement convention. No HTTP gateway/browser/auth transport is exercised.

Keyword-only embedding failure is intentionally injected in the runner's HTTP request hook; production fallback and degraded propagation run unchanged. This does not prove natural endpoint outage recovery.

EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE=1 is process-local to exercise actual batched embedding across compound facets; no running service configuration is changed. Rerank is disabled, matching the original recall configuration.
QA keyword recall 9/13; search_all keyword recall 12/13; any missing reference and degraded flag remains visible in per-run results.

No services, containers, volumes or source/index data modified; DB transaction is read-only and repeatable-read. Existing frozen source digests and ordered chunk-text fingerprints recorded, not rebuilt.
No project tests/lints/contracts generation, real answer model, visual check, browser chain, paid GPU, publication or human semantic review performed by this remeasurement.
